article.title: ALL art is political when you live in a genocidal dystopia
article.author: Caitlin A. Johnstone
article.content: I have no respect for this idea that art is somehow separable from politics. ALL art is political when you live in a genocidal dystopia, because all your expression exists in relation to our freakish civilization. The post ALL art is political when you live in a genocidal dystopia appeared first on MR Online .
